risks.risk: Missing accessories (especially HDMI cable) or incomplete bundle; seller may only show power cable.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo laid out showing every included item (console, both controllers if applicable, HDMI, power cable, headset/charging cables, manuals) with the boxes/receipts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a console-only / incomplete bundle (worst-case for missing HDMI/controller).

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/condition (original vs third-party; drift; broken buttons).
risks.proof: Video clip of both controllers being used in-game (showing button presses and analog movement) plus close-up photos of controller model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed (worst-case: treat as not included or unreliable).

risks.risk: Hardware faults not visible in photos (disc drive issues, USB port failure, HDMI output failure).
risks.proof: Short test video: connect HDMI to a TV, show boot screen, navigate menus, plug in USB device, and play a disc or load a game from external storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional (worst-case: assume ports/disc drive may be faulty).

risks.risk: Thermal issues or prior repair (overheating, fan noise, thermal paste problems).
risks.proof: Video clip of the console running a game for 15–20 minutes with fan noise audible; optionally show system temperature readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: Storage capacity mismatch (1TB vs 500GB) affects value; not readable from photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the Settings > Storage screen (or system info) showing total storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common capacity tier for PS4 Pro (worst-case).

proof_requests: Photo of the console rear/side ports and a close-up of the model/serial label (for exact PS4 Pro identification).
Video test: boot to home screen, confirm HDMI output on a TV, and test USB ports with a device.
Video test: insert a disc (if disc version) and show it loading; if no disc, show game loading from external storage.
Photo/video showing the full bundle laid out (console + all cables + controllers + HDMI) and the UK receipt (clear).
Photo of Settings > Storage (capacity) and controller model labels.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a PS4 Pro console and show some accessories, but key value drivers and risks (complete bundle, controller authenticity, port/disc functionality, storage capacity, and thermal condition) cannot be verified remotely from a single image. Proof is needed before a safe price.
